history.new: Low confidence. Not found in Knuth 1988, Arnoux 1989, Grabner et al. 1994, Messaoudi 2000 (read in full) or Ambroz-Frougny-Masakova-Pelantova 2003. The Historian derives from Messaoudi's Thm 2 that for canonical (Parry) sequences the associative shifts are upward-closed whatever the sign of beta; so the phenomenon concerns non-canonical initial values only (reviews/historian_C03_C10.md).
history.old: One web search (2026-10-18) and the abstracts of Knuth 1988, Arnoux 1989, Grabner et al. 1994, Math. Slovaca 50 (2000) did not mention non-monotone shift thresholds; low-confidence novelty pending the Historian audit.

history.new: Re-tested with certificates (EXP-C08-06, the same 90 quadratic sequences, shifts 0..10) - 6 rows of EXP-C08-04 listed shifts that are certified non-associative, including two of the original non-monotone examples ((4,3;1,5) at s = 4, (3,3;1,2) at s = 7). After the re-test 10 rows are still non-monotone, all with non-canonical initial values and beta < 0; none of the 30 rows with beta > 0. Isolated 'associative' shifts are supported by search only (no proof). Note that for G(k+1) = pG(k) + qG(k-1) with q > 0 the conjugate root is automatically negative.

history.new:
For quadratic Pisot base sequences G(k+1) = pG(k) + qG(k-1) with non-canonical initial values (for canonical
ones the associative shifts are upward closed whatever the sign of beta, by Messaoudi's Thm 2 as derived by
the Historian): if the conjugate root beta is positive, the set of shifts s for which o_s is associative is
upward-closed; sets that are not upward-closed (e.g. {2} and s >= 4 for G = 1,3,4,7,11,...) occur only when
beta < 0.
history.old:
For quadratic Pisot base sequences with real conjugate root beta > 0, the set of shifts s for which o_s is
associative is upward-closed. Sets that are not upward-closed (e.g. {2} and s >= 4 for G = 1,3,4,7,11,...)
occur only when beta < 0.

Isolated 'associative' shifts are supported by search only (no proof). Note that for G(k+1) = pG(k) + qG(k-1) with q > 0 the conjugate root is automatically negative. The Skeptic's review found the evidence of EXP-C08-04 contaminated - 31 of its 90 rows (8 with beta > 0) list certified-failing shifts as associative, and 4 of its 10 non-monotone rows are artefacts. After the targeted search EXP-C08-07 (shifts 0..12) 8 rows are non-monotone, all with beta < 0 and non-canonical initial values, and none of the 30 beta > 0 rows; the Skeptic's stronger search finds 0 of 231 beta > 0 sequences non-monotone (s <= 16) and 60 of 396 beta < 0 ones, none canonical.
